response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rfistat), overall AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL), qualifying AS (SELECT sa.rfistat, sa.avg_modindex, sa.avg_modindex - o.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg FROM status_averages AS sa CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE sa.avg_modindex > o.overall_avg) SELECT rfistat, avg_modindex, above_overall_avg, avg_modindex - AVG(avg_modindex) OVER () AS difference_from_qualifying_mean FROM qualifying;
